title: Aromatic Syrian Cannellini Beans Stew
description: A buttery, molten stew bursting with pistachio, sumac, and tomato, perfect for a plant‑based Mediterranean feast.

ingredients.name: canned cannellini beans, drained and rinsed
sea salt and black pepper, pinch

instructions: Heat olive oil and vegan butter in a large pot over medium heat until the butter foams.
Add the diced onion and sauté until translucent, about 4 minutes.
Stir in minced garlic and cook for an additional minute until fragrant.
Mix in tomato paste, smoked paprika, ground cumin, and sumac, stirring well to coat the vegetables.
Pour in the diced tomatoes and bring the mixture to a gentle simmer.
Add the drained cannellini beans, salt, and pepper, then reduce the heat to low.
Simmer uncovered for 15 minutes, stirring occasionally, until flavors meld and the stew thickens slightly.
Stir in the chopped parsley and squeeze in lemon juice, then adjust seasoning with additional salt or pepper if needed.
Remove the pot from heat and let the stew rest for 5 minutes before serving.
Ladle the aromatic stew into bowls, drizzle with a little extra olive oil if desired, and serve hot.
